text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the final day of the summer training camp,
I began timing Ikuno Dictus on a nearby
training course.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh——!!!!
choice_data_list: Looking good! Keep that pace up!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*, *haah*... *haah*...
Trainer... what is the result?
choice_data_list: Yes! You hit the target time!
Yes! You made the target time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What a relief...
We made it in time for the autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is fine-tuning our
adjustments.
Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. There you are.
Tomorrow is a spare day,
so you have no scheduled plans, correct?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case—I have a proposal.
Would you mind returning to retrieve our
bicycles right now?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The scenic viewpoint I wished to visit
lies just beyond the nearby mountain pass.
If you are willing,
would you care to accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Did you sleep well last night?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm feeling in top shape!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Physical condition optimal... check.
A mountain pass is a test of stamina,
so please do not overexert yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bicycle pedaled with surprising
smoothness.
With light, easy pedal strokes,
I ended up picking up speed without
realizing—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Apply your brakes for a moment.
And take a deep breath!
Please match my speed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
From here on,
the mountain pass gets steep.
Are you mentally prepared?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is the spirit. However,
do not rush ahead.
I will gauge our condition as we ride,
so let us proceed at a gentle pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was paying extra attention to me
today.
Ikuno Dictus felt even more dependable than
usual.
choice_data_list: You'd make a great trainer yourself.
You'd make a great trainer yoursel...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to act the part.
Before we depart,
let us stretch to loosen up our muscles.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The summer breeze and scent are quite
refreshing.
How are you feeling, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
The downhill section will be even more
exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After riding along the pass in high spirits
for 30 minutes,
the viewpoint was just ahead,
but my pace began to drop—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Your pedaling rhythm appears to be
faltering.
Is something amiss?
choice_data_list: Sorry, truth is, my legs are killi...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That explains it...
I should have noticed sooner.
How severe is the pain?
Do you think you can continue after
resting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus had really been looking forward
to today.
However,
pushing myself further would only cause more
trouble.
choice_data_list: I don't think I can make it up the...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, please, there is no need to apologize.
I have thoroughly enjoyed this ride,
as it has been a long time since my last.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary... how was it for you?
Given this was your first proper ride,
it must have been quite taxing in parts.
choice_data_list: It was fun... That's why I want to...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to hear that.
Let us gradually build up your endurance
for our next attempt.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Before we head back,
we should take a proper break.
If only there were a place where we could
sit down and rest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Down a forest path leading off the mountain
pass, I spotted a sign.
If my eyes weren't mistaken,
the letters read "CAFE."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. That blows away the fatigue,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look...
you can see the town nestled in the
mountains.
It looks picture-postcard perfect.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us enjoy the scenery while waiting to
recover.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We ended up savoring the view for quite a
long time.
...I wondered if the view from the lookout
point would have been just as beautiful.
choice_data_list: I really wanted to show you the vi...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please do not—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then,
fireworks appeared outside the window,
bursting with light so bright it made the
city lights fade.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh...
Could this be the final fireworks display
of the summer?
How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I do not regret being unable to reach
the viewpoint today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please look. At those beautiful fireworks.
And at this unhurried,
peaceful time we share.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Had we simply pressed forward without stopping,
we would have missed this entirely.
In fact,
we would never have known it existed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes,
relaxing your shoulders allows you to notice
new things.
Would you not agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were the exact words I had once taught
Ikuno Dictus.
I should have known it intellectually,
and yet...
choice_data_list: You got me... Our roles really wer...
You got me... Our roles really wer...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. This time,
it was your turn to realize it.
choice_data_list: You really have changed, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I would like to say yes,
but... it is not so simple.
I still inevitably place the highest priority
on efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems my fundamental nature cannot be
completely altered.
Neither in the past, nor in the future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The only time someone like me can slow
down
is when presented with an alternative
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
I would appreciate it if you could continue
to apply the brakes for me going forward.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is my line.
...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a resounding boom,
another firework burst into color.
No matter how many times I saw it,
it was breathtaking—
a sight I'd want to share again and again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me. Before I forget.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...There, that will do.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is something I rarely record...
A new, yet-to-be-scheduled entry.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Someday, another long ride together."
